label: internal transfers between revenue wallets on 2026-04-22
sql: SELECT block_date, block_timestamp_utc, receipt_id, receipt_predecessor_account_id AS from_wallet, receipt_receiver_account_id AS to_wallet, SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(args,'$.deposit') AS FLOAT64)/1e24 AS amount_near FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.receipt_actions` WHERE block_date = DATE '2026-04-22' AND action_kind='TRANSFER' AND receipt_predecessor_account_id IN ('fefundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near','1csfundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near','buybacks.multisignature.near') AND receipt_receiver_account_id IN ('fefundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near','1csfundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near','buybacks.multisignature.near') ORDER BY block_timestamp_utc
